issues.description: Stock exposes a public mutator setStockIngredients(StockIngredient[]), but the problem statement/UML for Stock only specifies add/take/findStockIngredient/addToStockIngredients/emptyStock. This extra public setter breaks the intended encapsulation of stock management and can mislead students about the required API.
issues.suggestedFix: Remove setStockIngredients(...) from template/solution, or reduce its visibility (e.g., package-private) and adjust any example code to initialize stock via addToStockIngredients(...) or acceptSupplyDelivery(...).

issues.description: The problem statement explicitly requires SealSaloon.calculateTotalPrice(Meal) to be static, but the solution implements calculateTotalPrice(Meal) as an instance method. This changes how students must call it (SealSaloon.calculateTotalPrice(...) vs saloon.calculateTotalPrice(...)) and can cause mismatches with tests/specification.
issues.suggestedFix: Make calculateTotalPrice(Meal) static in SealSaloon (and update call sites accordingly), or remove/adjust the static requirement in the problem statement/UML to match an instance method design.
